result.summary: The page has two notable visual problems: a broken/missing restaurant image in Popular, and a promo card overlapping the restaurant below it. Category chips and carousels clipped at the right edge are treated as intended horizontal scroll.

issues.description: The first Popular restaurant card (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a food photo, leaving a large empty gray area.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid restaurant image or use a designed fallback (e.g. cuisine icon) so the card is not visually empty.

issues.description: The large pizza promo card overlaps the Tokumaru Ramen Bar block: the restaurant name, rating, and meta sit above the image, and the card covers the lower part of that listing.
issues.suggestion: Give the Popular list item a proper stacked layout (image, then title/meta) and add spacing so the next card does not overlap.
